title: Mathematical proofs vs. intuition with examples

cues.en: Before getting too much further in this course, I want to say a few quick words about mathematical proofs versus intuitions.
cues.zh: 繼續課程前，想簡短談談數學證明和直覺。

cues.en: Now, proofs formal, rigorous proofs don't really play a large role in kind of earlier stages of mathematics.
cues.zh: 正式、嚴謹的證明，在數學初期通常角色不大。

cues.en: But once you get to higher studies in mathematics, I can calculus and linear algebra, differential
cues.zh: 但進到高等數學，例如微積分、線性代數、微分，

cues.en: equations, multivariable calculus and so on, proofs become more and more important.
cues.zh: 方程式、多變數微積分等等，證明就越來越重要。

cues.en: On the other hand, I focus in this course a lot more on intuition and using Python as a tool to build intuition relative to proofs.
cues.zh: 相較於證明，這門課更著重直覺，以及用Python建立直覺。

cues.en: And so I just want to say a few words about this.
cues.zh: 所以想簡單說幾句。

cues.en: So what is a proof?
cues.zh: 什麼是證明？

cues.en: Even so, a mathematical proof is a rigorous demonstration that an hypothesis or some claim about how
cues.zh: 數學證明，是嚴謹地說明某個假設、某個關於數學，

cues.en: something works in mathematics or a mathematical operation is true.
cues.zh: 運作或運算的論述，確實成立。

cues.en: And that rigorous demonstration is built on axioms.
cues.zh: 這個嚴謹說明，建立在公理上。

cues.en: It's built on previously proven claims.
cues.zh: 也建立在已證明的命題上。

cues.en: Now, the thing is that proving something in mathematics requires intellect.
cues.zh: 數學證明需要思考能力。

cues.en: It requires some creativity and some problem solving.
cues.zh: 也需要創意、解題能力。

cues.en: These are things that humans are really good at and computers are not necessarily so good at.
cues.zh: 這些人類很擅長，電腦不一定擅長。

cues.en: So when it comes to formal, rigorous demonstrations of mathematical proofs, I think computers or Python or any other program are kind of of limited benefit.
cues.zh: 因此，正式、嚴謹的數學證明，我覺得電腦、Python或其他程式，幫助有限。

cues.en: And you really need to be using your brain.
cues.zh: 真正需要動腦。

cues.en: In contrast, what Python or other numerical processing softwares can really help you with is building
cues.zh: 相對地，Python或其他數值處理軟體，能幫忙建立，

cues.en: intuition, in particular intuition with graphics, with visualization, with running through lots and lots and lots of examples.
cues.zh: 直覺，尤其透過圖形、視覺化，以及大量例子。

cues.en: And the idea here, which I also mentioned at the very beginning of this course, is that we trust that
cues.zh: 課程最開頭也提過，我們相信，

cues.en: computers are implementing the mathematical details, all the arithmetic and things accurately.
cues.zh: 電腦能精確處理數學細節、算術等等。

cues.en: And so therefore, we let the computers deal with the details and that frees up you, your your mind to think about intuition, think about important concepts.
cues.zh: 所以讓電腦處理細節，就能讓你的腦袋，專心思考直覺、重要概念。

cues.en: Now, when you're going through specific examples, it's a good idea to test several examples to avoid overgeneralizing from special cases.
cues.zh: 看具體例子時，最好測多個，避免從特例過度推廣。

cues.en: So that is to say, whenever you see a claim, you come across a claim in mathematics and you want to
cues.zh: 也就是，遇到數學論述，想，

cues.en: implement it in Python in order to understand it better, then it's a good idea to test different examples with different parameters or different variable values, different kinds of functions and so on.
cues.zh: 在Python實作來加深理解，最好測不同例子、參數、變數值、函數類型等等。

cues.en: And the reason why I'm bringing all this up is because going through mathematical proofs is really important in mathematics.
cues.zh: 提出這些，是因為數學證明很重要。

cues.en: It becomes more important as you get into areas like calculus and linear algebra.
cues.zh: 越進入微積分、線性代數等領域，越重要。

cues.en: However, in this course, for the rest of this course, I'm not really focusing on mathematical proofs.
cues.zh: 不過，本課接下來不會著重證明。

cues.en: Instead, I'm going to just make claims that are proven in theory.
cues.zh: 而會提出理論上已證明的論述。

cues.en: But I am focusing more on how you can use Python as a tool to build intuition about what those proofs
cues.zh: 重點是如何用Python，幫助直覺理解那些證明，

cues.en: actually mean, as opposed to walking through the detailed steps of building up those proofs from scratch from first principles.
cues.zh: 真正的意思，而非從基本原理開始，逐步建立證明。

cues.en: OK, so with that said, it is now time to begin our exploration of using Python to understand concepts in calculus.
cues.zh: 說完，現在開始用Python，探索微積分概念。
